text:
maria: Drafting release notes for the site — pushed PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/PR-5234. Main bits: policy-aware routing, embedding dedup, and small Console UX tweaks. Can folks quick-review?

devin: scanning now. could we tighten the lead to one short paragraph + 3 bullets? customers skip long prose. :thumbsup:

sam: heads-up — SDK v0.8 and earlier use `stream=True` while v0.9 renamed to `enable_stream`. need a Known Issue entry and an example for the migration guide.

sam: example snippet (python):
```python
# old (v0.8)
client.generate("...", stream=True)
# new (v0.9+)
client.generate("...", enable_stream=True)
```

ellie: saw a couple broken anchors after the docs anchor migration yesterday — specifically under /docs/api/console#model-routing -> now `/docs/api/console#routing-policy` so a few internal links 404. added notes in the PR comments with exact occurrences.

maria: thanks @ellie, can you paste the list of changed anchors into the PR so I can include a short "link update" note in the changelog?

ellie: done — pasted 6 anchors and the old->new mapping in the top comment. also added redirects.md suggestion.

chris-bot: changelog-build: succeeded (docs staging). preview: https://staging.docs.redwood/release/preview/5234 

devin: for the bullets i'm thinking: 1) policy-aware routing (faster cheaper fallbacks), 2) embedding dedup (reduces duplicate vector writes), 3) Console: per-route latency breakdown. Add a short "who it affects" line for each.

maria: draft lead and bullets added in the PR body. also added Known Issues section for the SDK streaming flag and anchors + a migration tip for Dedicated customers about pinned model versions.

sam: one more SDK nit — the JS SDK also changed streaming param name in the client. I'll add a small JS snippet and open a tiny docs PR to sync.

ellie: will add a small note under "Migration": run `redwoodctl check-links` after upgrade to catch anchor changes.

devin: ok — plan: ship draft to product marketing for 10:30am review, then finalize for midday publish. please reply here with "LGTM" if you approve wording or leave inline comments.

maria: LGTM except the Console bullet — tightened a phrase. pushed commit.

sam: LGTM (added JS snippet in follow-up commit).

ellie: LGTM from docs side, will follow up with redirect PR.

maria: thanks all — merging in 10m unless further feedback. :rocket:
